scraped.scraped_description: We partner with the rising global movement for economic democracy to build core technology, mobilize catalytic resources, and show the world that a better system is possible today.

name: One Project
tagline: Building infrastructure for economic democracy — connecting people, organisations, and resources to coordinate and grow a new economy
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 — Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Common platform not yet publicly launched at scale
failure_modes: platform dependency on single philanthropic founder
Common platform still in development / waitlist phase
curation_criteria: Community-led organisations focused on economic democracy and participatory governance; emphasis on organisations working toward equitable resource distribution
contributor_governance: Open source contribution guidelines; community input on platform development priorities
disparity_tracking: Horizon Fund explicitly tracks funding distribution to underrepresented communities and organisations led by people of color
community_ownership: Community-led organisations receive resources through Horizon Fund; Common platform designed to give communities control over capital allocation
ai_involvement: AI Commons publication exploring decentralised and community-led AI development
political_relevance_summary: One Project addresses gaps in democratic participation by providing tools or platforms that enable citizens and communities to engage more directly in governance and decision-making processes.

movement_building_utility.notes: One Project's primary function is not directly oriented toward civic organizing, advocacy, or movement infrastructure.

generalizability_notes: High generalizability. One Project is open source and already deployed across multiple countries/jurisdictions, making replication straightforward for other contexts.

dao_treasury_applicability.notes: Economic democracy infrastructure with DAO-compatible cooperative finance patterns; Horizon Fund analogous to DAO treasury
